Ruth (AE): Heads-up - Prospect wants a tightly-scoped 14-day POC: EU-only data plane, customer BYOK, and a dated subprocessor snapshot for the pilot window. Need a tech + price packet.
Ken (SE): Quick clarifying Q: control-plane telemetry ok as long as it's metadata-only?
Ruth (AE): Legal said yes for metadata-only control-plane. All payloads, logs, and traces must remain inside EU for the POC.
Yara (Ops): We can pin the tenant to eu-west-1 and enforce routing to EU pools. BYOK supported via our KMS connector in eu-west-1. BYO-HSM not feasible in two weeks. Need to verify which model variants are present in EU pools; some micro-optimized variants live only in other regions.
Mina (Trust): I'll generate the POC attestation + fill the SCQ. Ops must provide the subprocessors snapshot (storage provider, infra, monitoring) scoped to the POC dates. Also add clause: no cross-border failover during the pilot without 24h written notice.
Sam (Pricing): Note single-region pinning + BYOK and a reserved pool will increase costs. Preliminary two-week delta estimate:  ~  (I will post concrete numbers after we pick pool size).
Ken (SE): Proposed POC config (high level):
```
tenant_id: prospect-poc-2026
residency: EU
primary_pool: eu-west-1
standby_pool: eu-central-1 (EU-only)
models: prefer quantized EU variants, else same-family within EU
kms: external_key_arn -> mapped via connector
routing: strict_residency=true, fallback=queue_notify
observability: sink=obs-eu.redwood, trace-redaction=enabled
```
Yara (Ops): Important: strict_residency=true restricts autoscaling to EU capacity. If pool saturates we either queue or 429. Manual cross-border failover requires explicit signed approval and 24h notice per attestation.
Ruth (AE): Prospect is okay with queuing during POC but needs an escalation contact list and an agreement that manual failover will be coordinated with 24h notice.
Mina (Trust): Ops: please confirm where runtime traces currently export from and whether we can flip this tenant to EU-only sinks and apply redaction rules. I'll include that detail in the attestation.
Yara (Ops): Current default export: obs.redwood.global. For this tenant we can flip to obs-eu.redwood and enable per-tenant redaction. We'll produce a CSV snapshot of subprocessors dated for the POC window. Plan to push config during a small maintenance window.
Sam (Pricing): I'll prepare two quotes: minimal reserved pool (lower cost, potential queuing) and higher reserved pool (reduced latency risk). Linking internal quote when ready.
ci-bot: residency-pin apply requested for tenant prospect-poc-2026 -> job#9604 queued
Ken (SE): I'll prepare a short eval harness and sample prompts so the customer can compare quality/latency across EU-hosted variants vs our global defaults.
Ruth (AE): Action items: Ken draft tech packet + eval harness. Yara produce subprocessor snapshot + ops runbook + confirm model availability. Mina finalize attestation & SCQ. Sam post quotes. We'll deliver packet to customer tomorrow AM.
Sam (Pricing): Quote posted internally: https://redwood.internal/quotes/POC-1759991112 (internal)
Mina (Trust): I'll add the 24h no-failover clause and note redaction and EU-only retention for logs.
Ruth (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: — goal to start pilot next week if prospect signs.
